page.notes: The Greek word after "in hisce" is hard to read on the scan; the reading διάσημα is a guess and is marked [?]. The short dots before some lines (e.g. ".cis", ".an") are ink or bleed marks and were not transcribed. Printed long s and f-like forms were normalised to s as instructed (e.g. "faltem" as saltem, "Mefopotamia" as Mesopotamia). Two i/j readings were changed: "alijs" to aliis and "Officijs" to Officiis. No running head is printed on this page.
